Results of Operations and Financial Condition . Ford Motor Company (“Ford” or “Company”) hereby incorporates by reference its news release dated October 28, 2026, which is furnished as Exhibit 99 hereto. Beginning at 5:00 p.m. on October 28, 2026, Ford President and Chief Executive Officer Jim Farley, Chief Financial Officer Sherry House, and other members of Ford’s senior management team will host a conference call to discuss Ford’s third quarter 2026 financial results. Investors may access the webcast of the presentation at: https://ford-motor-company-q3-2026-earnings-call.open-exchange.net/ Pre-registration, which is recommended to expedite access to the webcast, is available at: https://ford-motor-company-q3-2026-earnings-call.open-exchange.net/registration The presentation and supporting materials are available at www.shareholder.ford.com . Representatives of the investment community will have the opportunity to ask questions on the call. Investors also may access replays of the presentation beginning after 8:00 p.m. the day of the event through November 4, 2026 at: https://ford-motor-company-q3-2026-earnings-call.open-exchange.net/ All times referenced above are in Eastern Time.
